_meta.description: The invoice layout per administration (REQ-SID-001), the customer's document language (REQ-SID-003) and the language recorded on the invoice for the invoice e-mail. Named zz- so its schema versions are the last ones declared for CustomerMaster and ARInvoice.

InvoiceLayout.title: Invoice layout
InvoiceLayout.description: How an administration's invoices look: logo, colours, template variant, footer and whether QR codes are printed (sales-invoice-document REQ-SID-001). One per administration.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: The administration this layout belongs to; one layout per administration (ADR-005).

logoFileId.title: Logo
logoFileId.description: The Nextcloud file id of the logo printed on the invoice.

primaryColor.title: Primary colour
primaryColor.description: Hex colour of headings and the table header; must reach WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) against white.

accentColor.title: Accent colour
accentColor.description: Hex colour of totals and links; must reach WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) against white.

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: Which of the three sales-invoice template variants the invoice uses.

footerText.title: Footer text
footerText.description: Text printed at the foot of every page, for example the chamber of commerce number and the payment terms.

showQr.title: Show QR codes
showQr.description: Whether the invoice carries the SEPA transfer QR and the pay link QR (REQ-SID-005).

language.title: Document language
language.description: The language of this customer's invoices and invoice e-mails; absent means the administration's default language (REQ-SID-003).

documentLanguage.title: Document language
documentLanguage.description: The language the invoice document was written in, taken from the customer when it is made; the invoice e-mail uses it too (REQ-SID-003).
